q: Match the number to its meaning: 5.02
n: Five-oh-two for a desk crew. Remember this: the five "magic numbers" are 0.65 (waiting, per person), 1.40 (conference/dining, per person), 5.02 (per staff desk), 7.43 (per bed), 4.65 (small fixed rooms). Waiting is the tightest because people only sit.
